capabilities: Sync notes, canvases, and binary files across users via Supabase
Lock files while editing with heartbeat and idle timeout
Resolve local/remote conflicts in a side-by-side diff modal
Create shared vaults and invite members by Vault ID
Run a guided setup wizard for Supabase configuration
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Users must create and configure their own Supabase project (free tier works), including running embedded SQL and creating a public storage bucket; a setup wizard walks through this.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Sync is single-user and paid, and there is no built-in way for several people to share and co-edit one vault with locking.

relations.evidence: Multi-user Obsidian vault sync via Supabase with real-time collaboration and file locking.

summary: Vault sync plugin that keeps a shared Obsidian vault in sync across multiple users via Supabase, with file locking and conflict resolution.
